'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Gabe DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gabe]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Username:''' Babomb dude
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
